items.summary: Fix the backend addUser function in main.mo so that when a new user is successfully created, a valid and unique user ID is generated and stored with the user record. The returned user object must include the assigned user ID. Ensure the ID is not empty, null, or undefined after creation.

Fix the UserManagementPage.tsx user table so that after a new user is created, the user's ID is correctly displayed in the user list/table panel. The table must render the user ID column value for every user row, including newly created users.

Fix the login flow so that newly created users (added via the Admin's Add User form) can successfully log in with their assigned email and password. Audit the backend login function in main.mo to ensure it looks up users by email against the full users map (including dynamically added users, not just pre-seeded accounts), verifies the hashed password correctly, and returns a valid session token and role on success. Ensure AuthContext.tsx correctly processes the login response and stores the token and role in sessionStorage.
